t: About someone you are at odds with now
a: ۞ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
p: ʿAsa-llāhu an yajʿala baynakum wa bayna-lladhīna ʿādaytum minhum mawaddah, wa-llāhu Qadīr…
m: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent, and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
